First listed 2025-10-17 · episode or wrap

The Bank Stock Rout: Facts vs Fiction | The Weekly Wrap

The October 17 wrap uses bank earnings supplements to distinguish isolated commercial-credit problems from system-wide distress. It explains bank valuation through tangible returns, argues for a merger cycle and reiterates the value of efficient scale competitors such as Progressive.

YouTube · 2025-10-17 ↗Substack · 2025-10-17 ↗
His process of comparing institutions and sizing losses is stronger than a headline-driven crisis call. Yet he overstates the universality of 2009 capital raising and turns a preference for bank takeovers into an overly exclusive reason to own regionals. The future normal-cycle view remains contingent.

How he reasons here

  • Use earnings to test the original thesis.
  • Compare credit trends across banks and normalize losses by size.
  • Link bank valuation to sustainable tangible returns.
  • Distinguish a funding crisis from ordinary credit losses.
